screen.formula: candidate_iteration_us = baseline_iteration_us - saved_component_us * calls_per_iteration * exposed_fraction; amortized_time_per_token = iteration_us / accepted_output_tokens_per_iteration
limitations: Bounds are supplied assumptions, not confidence intervals or independent validation.
Accepted progress includes all emitted output tokens per complete iteration; rollout length alone is insufficient.
Streaming gaps, queues, TTFT, tail latency, throughput and E2E require workload-specific measurement; a component speedup is not a service speedup.
Use CPU source-path, shape and correctness checks before a bounded GPU probe where those checks can falsify the mechanism.
